function ssrRender(_ctx, _push, _parent, _attrs) {
  _push(_ssrRenderComponent(_resolveComponent("Comp"), _attrs, {
    "row.top": _withCtx(({ r }, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
      if (_push) {
        _push(`${_ssrInterpolate(r)}`)
      } else {
        return [_createTextVNode(_toDisplayString(r))]
      }
    }),
    _: 1
  }, _parent))
}
